title: LOGOS ASF — TR-06B Evaluation Fixture Case
description: Contract for a single deterministic metadata evaluation fixture case. Fixture cases prove that specific candidate states produce expected TR-06A gate results (pass/fail/block/not_evaluated) or are rejected by the harness before gate execution. All fixture cases are metadata-only; no live inference occurs.

fixture_case_id.description: Deterministic identifier. Format: FC-<sha256[:16]>. Stable for same case_type.

case_type.description: Classification of this fixture case. Determines which candidate state is under test.

candidate_artifact_id.description: The model_artifact_id of the candidate exercised by this case.

candidate_mutations.description: Description of mutations applied to the base valid candidate to produce this case. Empty for valid_complete_metadata.

lineage_mutations.description: Description of mutations applied to the base lineage record to produce this case. Empty for valid_complete_metadata.

expected_gate_results.description: Mapping of evaluation_gate → expected result for gates that this case exercises. Gates not listed may return any valid result.

expected_harness_rejection.description: Whether the TR-06A harness should reject this candidate before gate execution (due to unsafe flags, forbidden fields, or wrong promotion_status).

requires_live_inference.description: Always false for TR-06B fixture cases. TR-06B exercises metadata-only gates.

metadata_only.description: Always true for TR-06B fixture cases.

notes.description: Human-readable explanation of what this fixture case proves.

x-invariants.metadata_only_const: metadata_only is const:true. TR-06B fixture cases never test live inference.
x-invariants.requires_live_inference_const: requires_live_inference is const:false. TR-06B fixtures are pure metadata.
x-invariants.no_promotion: No fixture case emits a promotion decision or sets promotion_blocked=false.
x-invariants.no_model_weights: No fixture case creates or references real model weight files.
x-invariants.no_training: No fixture case triggers real model training.
x-invariants.no_tr06c: TR-06C live behavioral eval interface was not started here.
x-invariants.no_tr07: TR-07 shadow/canary was not started here.
